story.title: The Last Summer of Orphée
story.subtitle: A composer’s listening party hides the extraction signal for a defecting cryptographer.
story.premise: composer Laurent Orphée's private first performance of his final suite, The Last Summer brings five accomplished strangers to a house in Grambois. Each accepted a different private promise from Laurent Orphée; one came to make sure that promise could never be kept.

characters.title: Concert pianist
characters.costume: 1960s Riviera evening wear suited to concert pianist
characters.publicFace: Volatile, brilliant, and incapable of polite indifference

characters.invitationPromise: Laurent promised you sole performance rights to the suite.
characters.privateIdentity: You carried coded scores for Laurent without understanding their recipients.
characters.privateObjective: Keep the suite intact and recover the rights Laurent promised.
characters.privateSecret: You changed one tempo marking to expose Laurent’s dependence on you.

solutionSteps.truth: Laurent’s suite contains an extraction time and route intended for a defecting cryptographer.

solutionSteps.title: The unresolved cadence
solutionSteps.truth: Conductor Victor Salvi killed Laurent because the final cadence identified Victor as the officer sent to stop the defection.

instructions.text: Invite Camille Duret to deliver only the prepared opening fact.

host.name: Laurent Orphée
host.title: Laurent Orphée, celebrated composer and clandestine signal writer; then Game Master

story.solutionSummary: Victor was the counter-intelligence officer embedded in Laurent’s musical circle. He recognized the extraction code during rehearsal and killed Laurent before the complete suite could be heard. He then blamed a rights dispute. Separate musical, financial, and personal memories prove Victor understood both route and target too early.

clues.text: The movement lengths encode a time shortly after midnight.
Victor requested the cottage passage be cut before its meaning was explained.
Each private promise gave one guest a reason to preserve a different movement.
The route hidden in the orchestration ends at the real cottage.
Victor knew the intended listener was a cryptographer, not a musician.

acts.playerGoal: Deliver only your short prepared cue and wait for the body to be discovered before bargaining begins.
